metric: Iceland imports from Nordic partner countries as share of selected food-group imports

source.name: Statistics Iceland imports by SITC and countries

method: Flattened existing JSON-stat response by SITC, partner country and month.
Mapped SITC 01,02,03,04,05 directly to food groups and summed SITC 41,42,43 as fats_oils.
Aggregated monthly values to annual values by commodity group.
Added selected_food_basket rows as totals across the six selected groups.
quality_notes: This file covers Iceland only because the existing Iceland raw response already includes partner country.
The broader all-country intra-Nordic indicator needs new partner-specific pulls for DK/FI and a source hunt or endpoint change for NO/SE.
2026 is a partial year in the source extract; use 2024 or 2025 for complete-year analysis unless the partial-year status is explicit.
Values use Statistics Iceland source units and should be used for shares, not cross-country value comparisons.
